content: statsmodels.tsa.holtwinters.ExponentialSmoothing (Holt linear / double exponential smoothing, optionally damped trend) is the standard lightweight transparent trend method; for very sparse data (2-3 points) plain OLS linear regression (numpy.polyfit or scipy.stats.linregress) on health-score-vs-time is simpler and equally transparent, with method escalation as more data accrues.
